title: A withheld delivery whose stale-begin checkpoint fails transiently keeps a conservative hold that only Resume clears
outcome: When the admission fence or dispatch card fails after Begin and the closing stale-begin checkpoint itself fails with a transport error or deadline (engram_host_adapter.rs:6113-6129 at be2ed177), the grant stays uncertain and the head keeps the conservative hold (w-25b4f98cec5f C2). Retry the checkpoint on the shared bounded schedule so a transient failure settles without Resume.
acceptance: A withheld delivery whose stale-begin checkpoint fails transiently keeps a conservative hold that only Resume clears is done
